technology_audit_question: Identify legal DAF sponsor, vendor, payment processor, custodian, advisor and legally protected fund owner
evidence_or_test_input: Actual sponsor EIN contracts and bank/custodian attestations
decision_or_expected_invariant: If company fails donor funds stay with licensed sponsor and sponsor can still grant
verification_method: Observed sponsor governing terms and authorized fund-flow receipt

technology_audit_question: Reconcile donor donations pending disbursement and company operating funds
evidence_or_test_input: Per-legal-entity bank ledgers balance reconciliation invoices and legal fiduciary controls
decision_or_expected_invariant: Do not allow software company insolvency to freeze unreconciled charitable distributions
verification_method: Authorized bank evidence and CPA review of safeguarded balances

technology_audit_question: Use balanced fund/custody subledgers with correction trail and cutoff rules
evidence_or_test_input: Synthetic accepted gift investment units fees grants returns and trial balance
decision_or_expected_invariant: No duplicate / orphan posting under replay and reversals; trial balance matches custody
verification_method: System demonstration, event ledger and independent accounting checks

technology_audit_question: Donor recommendation never equals legal sponsor grant approval
evidence_or_test_input: Role-separated workflows negative authorization cases and approval signatures
decision_or_expected_invariant: No payout or tax receipt from unaccepted gift or unapproved grant
verification_method: Observed sandbox action audit and scoped legal authority

technology_audit_question: Track initiated returned failed banked and externally confirmed money separately
evidence_or_test_input: ACH failed/refund webhooks statement matching recipient confirmation
decision_or_expected_invariant: At least once event and failed deposit cannot count as charity receipt
verification_method: External bank plus nonprofit reconciliation evidence

technology_audit_question: Manage versioned money APIs idempotent grant creations race conditions and retries
evidence_or_test_input: Documented API changelog replay/duplicate and concurrency tests
decision_or_expected_invariant: Exact once financial posting despite at least once delivery
verification_method: Repeatable vendor sandbox and trace logs

technology_audit_question: Support regulator audit from donor intent through sponsor approval, payment, nonprofit receipt
evidence_or_test_input: Immutable event IDs effective dates signed approval provenance retention policies
decision_or_expected_invariant: Each grant traced from origin to end state; old evidence retained after mutation
verification_method: Synthetic trace with chain-of-custody export

technology_audit_question: Enforce correct advisor vs donor vs sponsor roles and nonprofit anonymity preferences
evidence_or_test_input: Cross-client unauthorized access and public/private donor field tests
decision_or_expected_invariant: No leaked donor contribution data, consent not inferred by channel
verification_method: Authorized negative API and UX tests

technology_audit_question: Request current SOC report actual controls report period CUECs subservice
evidence_or_test_input: Scoped independent SOC1/SOC2, pen test and remediation, encryption key custody
decision_or_expected_invariant: Do not infer current DAF system assurance from historic affiliate marketing
verification_method: Auditor documents under NDA and sponsor control mapping

technology_audit_question: Verify timely security detection escalation customer notification and restoration

decision_or_expected_invariant: Public status accurate, independent disclosure controls and internal escalations
verification_method: Permitted tabletop and redacted prior incident postmortem

evidence_or_test_input: Escrow exports staff roles alternate processor independent control
